explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, and nonzero only at GO when the agent chooses a1 and the previous trial ended with a reward in S1 (normally a1 reaching S1 by the common route); then it is usually 8-10, mostly 9-10 in the middle of the episode (trials 50-70), and it falls slowly over a long streak of S1 rewards (10 -> 9 -> 8). It is 0 at GO whenever the agent chooses a2, the previous trial was unrewarded, or the last reward came in S2 (for example a1 reaching S2 by the rare route and paying), and in some stretches with a1 and S1 rewards it only reaches 3-7, or even 0.
